title: Review of c23's CIPS inhibitor finding: no division replicates, but coarsening is slowed, not arrested (seeds 5-6 to t=6000: inhibited counts fall 40->33 and 41->30 by ripening while the twins fall to 35 and 34)
summary: Re-ran the inhibitor world and its kI=0 twin on fresh seeds 5 and 6 for twice the claim's duration, plus dt/2 on seed 5. No droplet splits in any run and the inhibitor cuts merges ~4x (10-11 vs 40-42); dt/2 reproduces the counts exactly. But the body count is not flat after t~1500: it falls 17% on seed 6 between t=1500 and 3000 (twins 15%) and keeps falling to t=6000 through dissolution of small droplets, ending at 33/30 bodies against 35/34 without inhibitor. Weak: slowed coarsening, not arrest.

observations.finding: rerun/inh/seed5, seed6: 0 splits, merges 11/10 vs 40/42 in rerun/noI; counts t=1500->3000->6000: 40->37->33 and 41->34->30 vs 55->47->35 and 53->45->34

seeds_run.result: partial: no division and fewer merges replicate; count falls 40->37 (t 1500-3000) and to 33 by t=6000
fail for the arrest: count falls 41->34 between t=1500 and 3000, as fast as the twin; no division replicates

controls_run.finding: rerun/noI (kI=0 twins, same seeds, grid, duration); rerun/inh_dt2 and rerun/noI_dt2 (world dt halved)

verdicts.limitation: Two fresh seeds and one parameter set (the finding's p_c); runs to t=6000 only, so a later plateau of the inhibited arm cannot be excluded; counts are labkit components at threshold 0.5.
